definition: Samy Bengio (born 1965) is a Canadian computer scientist working as senior director of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Research at Apple.
details: Samy Bengio (born 1965) is a Canadian computer scientist working as senior director of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Research at Apple.

explainer.lead: Samy Bengio is a Canadian computer scientist (born 1965).

contributions.name: According to DBLP, Bengio has authored around 250 scientific papers on neural networks, machine learning, deep learning, statistics, computer vision and natural language processing.
He was a longtime scientist at Google, where he led a large group of researchers working in machine learning, including adversarial settings.
He is a co-author of Torch, the ancestor of PyTorch, one of today's two largest machine learning frameworks.

timeline.what: Doctor of Philosophy, Université de Montréal
